static_traits.name: Mei Lisha
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues and friends are strained due to feelings of self-smallness and self-deprecation; has friends to confide in but has not shared for fear of being judged or not understood
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems occurred; has not previously received psychotherapy; no major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt that even being a genius is meaningless, because many people have the same IQ as me, which makes me feel unimportant and devalue my abilities.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to get rid of this doubt and sense of smallness. I hope to have more confidence in my abilities and build better relationships with the people around me.

core_beliefs: I am not important / my ability has no value
My worth depends on whether I am smarter than others

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are recognized for their intelligence and I am not recognized, it means I am not smart enough and I am not important
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking others' approval and engaging in self-improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My talent is meaningless; I am not important

special_situations.event: In social settings or when discussing intellectual topics with others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform smarter than others, it means I do not belong here
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becomes defensive in these situations and shares fewer true feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are judging me; I do not belong here

special_situations.event: 会议中我的想法not yet被采纳
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my suggestion is rejected, it proves my contribution has no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further seeking external recognition while doubting oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My contribution is worthless; I may not be as smart as I think

special_situations.event: Thinking that many people have a similar intelligence level to mine
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my intelligence is not unique, then it has no meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Engaging in self-improvement to try to stand out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Being a genius is meaningless; my ability does not matter

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, seen, and have own worth confirmed (especially intellect and contributions)
core_conflict.fear: Fears being denied, failing in comparisons, and being judged, thereby experiencing a sense of self-worthlessness
defense_goal: Reduces the hurt of rejection by seeking external recognition, maintaining defensiveness, and reducing self-disclosure

object_relations.self_representation: 渺小且not被重视的贡献者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others do not adopt her views or she feels judged
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the other party looks down on them and judges them (projecting past experiences of comparison and negation onto the current relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious and defensive tone, emphasizes their own rationality, avoids excessive self-exposure; if pressed, uses conditional sentences and hypothetical statements to protect boundaries.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing topics such as self-worth and 'whether I am smarter than others'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Converts emotional experience into rational discussion of intelligence rankings and efficiency, to avoid touching on shame and vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses an analytical tone, focuses on facts and logic, and reduces expression of emotional vocabulary and self-feelings.

manifestations: Feels that 'even being a genius is meaningless'; this feeling is more easily triggered when seeing others recognized or in intellectual discussions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Feeling that others are judging oneself in social settings
In meetings, attributing doubts about one's own worth to others' negation and looking down on oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Does not share true feelings with friends out of worry about being judged
Becoming defensive and extra cautious in social settings

exception_events.target_problem: In meeting or social discussion situations, Melissa usually doubts herself when others do not adopt her views and feels that her contributions have no value, which in turn affects relationships and work motivation.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a previous project, her work and contributions were well received and recognized, and she felt competent and appreciated at the time.
exception_events.reason: Different support / context: in this project, her output received positive feedback and recognition, making it easier for her to experience competence and value.

positive_force: Having had recognized project experience, able to recall states of competence and being appreciated
Proactively seeking support and attempts at self-improvement
Able to notice and name negative thinking patterns (such as disqualifying the positive, mental filtering)
Having some social support (friends to talk to)
negative_force: Excessively comparing and relying on external approval to determine self-worth
Disqualifying the positive evidence (Disqualifying the Positive)
Mental filtering (focusing only on others' negations)
A tendency toward overgeneralization and jumping to the worst conclusion
Fear of being judged leads to defensiveness and reduced self-expression

target_behavior.behavior: Shows strong self-doubt and defensive reactions in meetings and social discussions (self-deprecation, reduced self-expression)
antecedent: Seeing a colleague recognized for intelligence
In social settings or when discussing intellectual topics
target_behavior.core_reason: Overly builds self-worth on 'whether I am smarter than others and whether I am recognized', and engages in negative comparison and filtering of their own abilities
target_behavior.function: Escaping the negative experience of being judged and rejected, maintaining a sense of psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships are strained, self-esteem is damaged, confidence declines, and work motivation and productivity decrease
